correctness.rationale: For a twist-commuting E, the 1+2 block form and E²=I imply a²=1 and q(p+s)=0. Direct Hom-Nijenhuis/integrability equations include q²(2a+p+s)=0, forcing q=0 in characteristic≠2. The surviving sign cases, excluding ±I, give exactly ±α and two affine E±(r). The perfect morphism identity on (e1,e2,e1) excludes both affine families; g preserving bracket and twist has matrix x, y, w, x²y with x,y≠0, and conjugation moves r by ±2w/y, hence exactly four orbits and 2q+2 points over odd Fq. Independent enumeration using original basis-triple integrability for F3,F5 found exactly 8 and 12 qualifying matrices, matching two affine families and two isolated points; infinite-field proof is symbolic.
residual_risks: The product identity is referenced to the original manuscript; verified against its Definition 4.1 and Example 4.17, with the characteristic-2 exclusion essential.
The finite check covers q=3,5; arbitrary fields rely on explicit polynomial case split.
